result: The authors used an inducible-intersectional genetic strategy combining Brn3aCKOAP and NFL-IRES-CreER alleles to label a subset of sensory neurons. result: Brn3a+/− heterozygous mice used in the study are indistinguishable from wild-type in appearance and health, and a compensatory autoregulation mechanism leads to near-normal expression levels of Brn3a-regulated transcripts, suggesting these neurons do not differ functionally or morphologically from wild-type.

result: The authors surveyed back skin at P21 from 101 mice, examining 1569 cm² total area, characterizing 719 arbors and fully reconstructing 77 arbors across nine types. Back skin was chosen for its variety of sensory types and large area, and P21 was selected to avoid melanin interference during the telogen phase.
